edits.new:
For each enumerated subject, identify the broader subjects it represents in the post. Use these relationships to build the hierarchy upward, combining shared headings. Retain every enumerated subject as an entry, including it in each branch whose broader subject it refines. Give every heading and subheading its own entry.

A child's `subject` heading must refine its parent's meaning: every post about the child would also be about the parent. This relationship must hold without borrowing restrictions from `context` or the source post.
